title: Cygnett 45W Wall Charger with Retractable Cable White $30 + $9.99 Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ $120 Order) @ Anaconda
body:
Deal: Cygnett 45W Wall Charger with Retractable Cable White $30 + $9.99 Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ $120 Order) @ Anaconda

[huggle] Good price. No stock for Click and Collect in VIC
[Ni l s] You could try to price match at JB or Harvey Norman
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/products/cygnett-powerplus-45w-wal…
https://www.harveynorman.com.au/cygnett-powerplus-45w-usb-c-…
[huggle] The HN declined to price match because it is a clearance item. The JB Online queue is currently very long, I’m still waiting 😅
[El Chyeah] This 65w charger from Officeworks has served me well, same price and free pick up or onepass free shipping, multiple colours available (I have linked to black):
https://www.officeworks.com.au/shop/officeworks/p/otto-onthe…
[camshandez] seems like a valid recommendation
OP's Cygnett = 45w, 80 cm cable, 2 5 Years warranty
Otto = 65w, 70cm cable, 3 years warranty.
unsure of specific charging protocol differences, but with the Otto being 20w more powerful and extra year warranty (high value on a retractable cable unit) it's a decent deal if a 10cm shorter cable isn't a problem.
EDIT - Cable retract side is also a factor depending on your plug orientation.
Cygnett website also lists "NEW 5 Year Warranty" so that makes it a tougher pick.
[ce5himm] Any one know whether this one support Samsung super charge 2.0?
[jimojr] ChatGPT says yes, Gemini Flash says no.
Why It Doesn't Support SFC 2.0:
Current Requirement: Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0 requires a charger that supports Programmable Power Supply (PPS) with at least 4.05A to 5A output in the 5V–11V range (along with a 5A-rated cable).
Cygnett Specs: The Cygnett charger's PPS output is limited to a maximum of 3.25A in the 5V–11V range (5.0–11.0V ⎓ 3.25A).
[ce5himm] So we need third AI to tell me which AI should I trust
[russbuss] I have the 65W version and can confirm it supports Samsung super charge 2.0 for my S25U. Not sure about this 45W version
[benjamen50] Here's the info pulled from the manufacturer's product page:
USB-C Port & USB-C Cable Output
5.0V⎓3.0A (15.0W); 9.0V⎓3.0A (27.0W); 12.0V⎓3.0A (36.0W); 15.0V⎓3.0A (45.0W); 20V⎓2.25A (45.0W)
USB-C Port + USB-C Cable Output
5.0V⎓3.4A (17.0W) PPS; 5.0-11V⎓3.25A PPS: 5.0-21v-2.15A
Why is there two outputs specified? I don't really know.
Source: https://www.cygnett.com/products/powerplus-45w-wall-charger-…
SFC 2.0 relies on the PPS standard. You have 45W so it's fine.
[jimojr] SFC 2.0 relies on the PPS standard. You have 45W so it's fine.
That's not quite right. While 45W total power is enough, Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0 relies on 5A PPS (specifically 9V-11V at 4.05A–5A). Because this retractable cable is only rated for 3A, the charger will drop back to standard Super Fast Charging at 25W. Not sure why I'm getting downvoted for this.
[Clear] Retractable cable chargers are so cool. I had some 65W PPS OEM ones produced in China and haven't looked back since.
Obviously it'll be a sad day when/if the cables break.
[cooni] 100% the retractable cable will break soon enough
[Ni l s] All Cygnett products include a 2-year warranty
[Qyzbud] JB Hi-Fi listing claims 5 years even
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/products/cygnett-powerplus-45w-wal…
[kenmizuki] https://www.cygnett.com/products/powerplus-45w-wall-charger-…
5 years, but cable breaking is physical damage , I dont think warranty will cover it
[Qyzbud] @kenmizuki: You might be right, but that page makes specific note of the cable mechanism being rigorously tested, so it sounds like they are backing it for durability
